commands.review_summary:
The PR adds a `WKUIDelegate` JavaScript confirm-panel handler in `DashboardWindowController` so embedded dashboard `window.confirm()` calls can show a native `NSAlert`.

PR surface: Other +27. Total +27 across 1 file.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: selected-session deletion calls `window.confirm`, and current main's macOS `DashboardWindowController` has no JavaScript confirm handler even though WebKit treats an unimplemented confirm handler as Cancel. I did not run a live macOS app reproduction in this read-only review.

target.title: fix(macos): implement JavaScript confirm panel handler for dashboard …
target.body:
…Web UI

Fixes #99286. The embedded Control UI uses window.confirm() for delete confirmation, but DashboardWindowController only implemented the file open panel handler. This caused delete operations to silently fail without showing any dialog.

Adds the missing runJavaScriptConfirmPanelWithMessage delegate method that bridges to NSAlert, matching the existing runOpenPanelWith pattern.

[AI] Assistance by deepseek-v4-flash
